message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short-Term Asset Growth Dispersion", "construction": "Compute the standard deviation of quarterly growth rates in total assets over the past eight quarters.", "rationale": "Firms with more volatile asset growth may reflect uncertainty or inconsistent investment, possibly linked with mispricing or risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Relative Segment Revenue Growth", "construction": "For firms with business segments, calculate the difference between the revenue growth rate of the fastest growing segment and the slowest over the past year.", "rationale": "High dispersion in segment growth may indicate emerging business strengths not captured in aggregate numbers.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "R&D Intensity Acceleration", "construction": "Take the year-over-year change in the ratio of R&D expense to sales over the past two years.", "rationale": "An increasing trend in R&D investment intensity may signal upcoming innovation and positive future prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Net Operating Cycle Reduction", "construction": "Compute the change in the net operating cycle (days inventory outstanding plus days sales outstanding minus days payables outstanding) over the past year.", "rationale": "Firms reducing their net operating cycle may be improving efficiency and liquidity, likely undervalued by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "large negative values of the measure"}, {"name": "Negative Analyst EPS Revision Momentum", "construction": "Sum all negative changes in consensus next-year EPS estimates over the past six months, scaled by beginning-of-period EPS estimate.", "rationale": "Markets might overreact to clusters of downward revisions, leading to potential reversals.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Long-Term Deferred Tax Liability Growth", "construction": "Calculate the two-year compound annual growth rate in long-term deferred tax liabilities.", "rationale": "Rising deferred tax liabilities may signal growing temporary differences and potential for future earnings growth.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Insider Sale-to-Buy Skewness", "construction": "Take the skewness of dollar value of insider sales minus purchases over the past 12 months.", "rationale": "Extreme skewness, indicating rare but large insider purchases, may reflect undervalued situations missed by aggregate measures.", "higher_returns_for": "very negative values of the measure"}, {"name": "Recent Off-Balance Sheet Commitment Growth", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage change in total undiscounted operating lease obligations disclosed in footnotes.", "rationale": "Firms increasing off-balance sheet commitments may be positioning for future growth not visible in standard leverage ratios.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Customer Concentration Change", "construction": "Change in the percentage of revenue from the top three customers as disclosed in 10-Ks over the past two years.", "rationale": "Decreasing dependence on major customers may signal business diversification and lower risk.", "higher_returns_for": "large negative values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Initiation Relative Volume Spike", "construction": "For firms newly initiating dividends, calculate the ratio of average trading volume in the 10 days post-announcement to the 30-day pre-announcement average.", "rationale": "Unusually high volume after dividend initiations may indicate information diffusion or increased investor attention.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}]}
